exposure: Three groups based on mother's advised amount of gestational weight gain
outcome: Total serum bilirubin (TSB) levels at 2nd, 5th, and 15th postnatal days
cohort: Term and healthy infants born between 38 and 42 weeks.
finding: Babies born to mothers who gained more weight than advised during pregnancy had statistically significantly higher bilirubin levels on the 5th and 15th postnatal days and higher hematocrit levels compared to other groups.
